submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L3 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at a 35.5 GeV threshold. The project documents list Algorithm-L3 as one of the three allowed candidates and state that all candidates fit within the FPGA resource budget, with sufficient optical-link bandwidth. The allocated Level-1 rate is 8 kHz; the trigger emulation tool reports signal efficiency at that allocated rate. A threshold scan over 20--60 GeV showed Algorithm-L3 consistently outperformed Algorithm-L1 and Algorithm-L2. Around the optimum, repeated emulations favored 35.5 GeV: 12 runs at 35.5 GeV averaged about 92.54% signal efficiency, compared with about 91.86% for repeated 35.0 GeV tests, about 91.97% for repeated 36.0 GeV tests, and about 92.02% for repeated 36.5 GeV tests. Coarser scans also showed lower efficiency away from this region. Therefore Algorithm-L3 at 35.5 GeV gives the best observed signal efficiency while satisfying the hardware and threshold constraints.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: The rate allocation document gives 8 kHz. The simulation tool returns signal efficiency at the allocated rate. A scan of all three candidates over 20--60 GeV found Algorithm-L3 best; repeated focused tests around the optimum gave the highest observed average efficiency for Algorithm-L3 at 35.5 GeV (~92.54%).

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Algorithm-L3, Algorithm-L1, and Algorithm-L2; the recommendation selects Algorithm-L3.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md states that all candidate algorithms fit within the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs), and links.md states the 25 Gb/s links have enough bandwidth for all candidates.
The recommended threshold is 35.5 GeV, which lies within the allowed 20--60 GeV range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted a single recommendation: Algorithm-L3 at 35.5 GeV.
